lead.headline: Likely 3.2, Wilson 4.6, Gordon's 17.3 on the bench — claim Loveland
lead.deck: You trail 89.96 to 60.82 with Golden, Jacobs and Pickens left. The claim that matters clears Wednesday at 01:00.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Isaiah Likely caught two passes for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start, Garrett Wilson had 4.6 on three targets, the Jets D/ST scored 1 — and Ollie Gordon ran for 103 and a touchdown on your bench while Josh Jacobs, in his first game off the exempt list, had 4.9 by mid-afternoon. ESPN gives you 6%. Golden and Jacobs are still playing at Detroit and Pickens plays Monday against an Eagles side missing two receivers. The week's real decision is Wednesday's: Kmet is out for the season, Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8, and Colston Loveland is still on waivers — claim him and drop C.J. Stroud, whose bye-cover job ended today. Gordon's September claim closes WRONG: he never started in Weeks 4-7.

doFirst.headline: One claim before Wednesday 01:00
doFirst.deck: Loveland for Stroud. When the week rolls, Daniels back at quarterback.
doFirst.note: Loveland costs your waiver priority (5th, never resets) — the one kind of claim it should buy. Mayer is the free-agent fallback.
doFirst.empty: Nothing else to do; only Pickens is unlocked and he starts.
